mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from Woodford Green IG8 to Heathrow Airport?

mainEntity.name: How far is Woodford Green IG8 from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Woodford Green IG8 is approximately 22 miles (35 km) from Heathrow Airport via the A104 southbound connecting to the A406 North Circular and then the A40 westbound towards Heathrow. Journey times typically range from 45 to 70 minutes depending on traffic conditions along the A406 corridor and the A40 westbound approach.
